description: Pay a USD order without its link, by one of its payment.methods: a Stripe shared payment token, only if you can request one from the user's Link wallet (US and Canadian accounts; never ask the user for one), or Alipay/WeChat Pay (method stripe_alipay_wechat_pay). Call it only after the user confirmed the order's total and currency, the stay and every term with a clear yes. Token: request it with the entry's handler config.business_profile and limits, and pass it with price.total; a token pays one order. Wallet: pass method and price.total, then show the entry it returns: the WeChat code as an image if you can, and both links; the user pays once, by either. A code lasts 120 minutes; then the WeChat link opens a new one, or call again. Pay one way only: success closes payment.url, a failure leaves it open, and each error says how to recover. Then poll get_order.

method.description: Pay by a method in payment.methods other than the token, which is paid with sharedPaymentToken or payment. Exactly one of sharedPaymentToken, payment and method.

orderId.description: The orderId of the order to pay.

payment.description: UCP's Complete Checkout payment, in place of sharedPaymentToken: the token as the stripe_payment_token credential of the one selected stripe_payments card instrument. Exactly one of sharedPaymentToken, payment and method.

instruments.description: The instruments, exactly one of them selected.

credential.description: The instrument's credential: for the selected one, the shared payment token.

token.description: The shared payment token (spt_…) the user approved for this order, requested with the limits of the order's stripe_shared_payment_token method.

type.description: The credential type: stripe_payment_token for the selected one.

display.description: How the wallet shows the instrument, as UCP has it. Not used to pay.

handler_id.description: The id of the handler the instrument pays through: the order's stripe_payments for the selected one.

id.description: The instrument's id, as the agent's UCP client names it.

selected.description: Whether this is the instrument to pay with. Exactly one is selected; a lone instrument without it is the one.

type.description: The instrument type: card for the selected one. A Link token is presented as a card instrument, whatever Link funds it with.

sharedPaymentToken.description: The shared payment token (spt_…) the user approved for this order, requested with the limits of the order's stripe_shared_payment_token method. Exactly one of sharedPaymentToken, payment and method.

total.description: The total the user approved: the order's price.total, in its currency, exactly as returned.

amount.description: Decimal string such as 132.40, never a number.

name: pay_order

cancel.description: Whether the order can be cancelled now, and for what penalty and refund.

available.description: Whether the user can cancel the order now, or, unpaid (reason unpaid), close it.

penalty.description: The penalty if cancelled now, under the accepted terms, in the charge currency; null when not stated, except on an unpaid order (reason unpaid), where null means closing it charges nothing.

reason.description: cancellable: a paid order can be cancelled now; unpaid: an unpaid order can be closed; otherwise why not.

refund.description: What a cancellation now refunds: what was paid less the penalty, in the charge currency; null when not stated.

cancellation.description: The terms the order was made on, read at asOf; cancel says whether it can be cancelled now.

asOf.description: When these terms were read: status and penalties are as of this time.

meals.description: What the rate includes to eat. known false: the meals are unknown, not none, and included, unspecifiedMainMeals and allInclusive are null.

guestsCoveredPerRoom.description: How many guests in each room the meals are for; fewer than the guests in the room means not everyone gets them. null when not stated.

unspecifiedMainMeals.description: Main meals a day beyond included that the rate doesn't name (e.g. 1 when a half-board rate doesn't say lunch or dinner); null when known is false.

payAtProperty.description: Fees paid at the property, on top of price.total, in the property's currency, not converted. disclosure incomplete: there may be fees not listed.

chargeCurrency.description: USD or CNY: the currency of the offer the order was made from. An order made on the Fortrip website may be in another currency.

expiresAt.description: When the time to pay ends: an order unpaid by then expires, with nothing charged. null unless status is awaiting_payment.

localCharge.description: What the card was charged in its own currency, when Stripe converted the total; otherwise null. Always null on a CNY order.

localCurrencyAtCheckout.description: Whether paying by url may charge the card in its own currency, converted by Stripe; false once paid by token, or by Alipay or WeChat Pay through pay_order or the Fortrip page; always false on a CNY order.

methods.description: What pay_order accepts for this order now, by id. [] means: give the user payment.url, when it isn't null.

anyOf.description: A Stripe shared payment token, through pay_order's sharedPaymentToken or payment. The entry is absent when a token can't pay this order (for example over $500, not charged in USD, or started on the Fortrip website); then give payment.url or use another entry.

handler.description: The com.stripe.payments handler, which takes the token.

limits.description: What the shared payment token for pay_order must allow.

currency.description: The token's currency, lowercase as Stripe takes it: usd.

expiresAt.description: Request the token valid until at least this time; the order can't be paid after it.

maxAmount.description: Request the token for at least this amount, in cents; a token that allows less can't pay.

anyOf.description: Paying with Alipay or WeChat Pay: pass method stripe_alipay_wechat_pay to pay_order to open it. The entry is absent when the order can't be paid this way and none is open, as on a CNY order.

url.description: A link, on fortrip.ai, for the user to pay with Alipay; anyone holding it can pay.

alipay.description: The Alipay link; null until the payment is open.

current.description: Which of the two the payment is on now; null until it is open.

open.description: Whether pay_order has opened an Alipay or WeChat Pay payment on this order.

qrData.description: The WeChat Pay code's content, to draw as a QR code; null when there is no live code (open wechatPay.url for one).

qrImageUrl.description: A 480 px PNG of the same code.

url.description: A link, on fortrip.ai, for the user to pay with WeChat Pay; anyone holding it can pay.

wechatPay.description: The WeChat Pay code and link; null until the payment is open.

url.description: The payment page, on fortrip.ai; it continues to the payment provider. With requiresSignIn false anyone holding it can pay; with requiresSignIn true (an order started on the Fortrip website) it continues to the Fortrip booking page, where only the signed-in owner can pay. null while a payment is held (authorized) or when the order isn't awaiting payment, or, while it is and its payment is unpaid, while a payment is being processed: read the order again shortly, and don't give an earlier link.

total.description: The whole stay for all rooms, in payment.chargeCurrency: what paying charges, or once paid what was charged. Fees payable at the property are not in it.

status.description: awaiting_payment: not paid yet (a payment just made may still be settling); payable until payment.expiresAt. expired: not paid; the time ran out or the order was closed. Nothing charged. confirming: paid or held, the booking is with the hotel. confirmed: the hotel confirmed and the payment is charged. failed: no stay was booked; payment.status says what became of the money. cancelling, then cancelled: a cancellation under the terms. needs_attention: a person at Fortrip has to resolve it.

title: Pay order
